name: Missing Bump Seed Canonicalization
description: create_program_address accepts any bump that lands on a valid address, so a caller-supplied bump can derive a second, non-canonical PDA for the same seeds. find_program_address returns the canonical bump and is what a derivation should be checked against.

name: Missing Signer Check
description: When an instruction does not verify that a caller signed the transaction, any account may be passed in its place. Anchor proves this with a Signer field, or the handler can check is_signer directly.
